criteria.name: Contrast (Minimum)
criteria.consequence: Text and buttons fall below the 4.5:1 ratio — washed out and unreadable for ageing eyes and low contrast sensitivity.
criteria.evidence: 31 pa11y errors on aquavena.nc; 26 failing nodes confirmed by Lighthouse.

criteria.name: Resize Text
criteria.consequence: Pinch-zoom is disabled, so the page cannot be enlarged on a phone — the single most common low-vision coping strategy.
criteria.evidence: meta viewport sets user-scalable=no and maximum-scale=1.0 on aquavena.nc — pinch-zoom disabled.
